info.title: AgentGuard API
info.description: Controlled research API for multi-agent information-flow investigation. WARDEN workflows use a durable idempotency journal; the default research backend remains synthetic. A completed workflow is not, by itself, proof of causal validity.

get.description:
Metadata-based risk findings and falsifiable hypotheses.

Findings are structural signals over recorded interaction metadata.
Uncalibrated scores are never attack probabilities, candidates are not
causal claims, and missing evidence is reported as
``available=false`` / ``insufficient_evidence`` rather than fabricated.

post.description:
Run a multi-round investigation loop (operator/approval credential).

Requires the configured Operator credential or approval token. A plain
API token only passes the optional global API gate. The idempotency
header is required; retries with the same key and payload return the
existing loop.

parameters.name: X-AgentGuard-Operator-Token

schema.description: Configured route-level Operator credential. Either this header or a valid X-Approval-Token is required.
schema.title: X-Agentguard-Operator-Token

parameters.description: Configured route-level Operator credential. Either this header or a valid X-Approval-Token is required.

parameters.name: X-Approval-Token

schema.description: Configured route-level approval credential. Either this header or a valid X-AgentGuard-Operator-Token is required.
schema.title: X-Approval-Token

parameters.description: Configured route-level approval credential. Either this header or a valid X-AgentGuard-Operator-Token is required.

parameters.name: X-Loop-Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Required stable retry key. The same key and same request returns the existing Loop; changed request fields conflict.
schema.title: X-Loop-Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Required stable retry key. The same key and same request returns the existing Loop; changed request fields conflict.

parameters.name: X-AgentGuard-Token

schema.description: Conditional global API credential: required when AGENTGUARD_API_TOKEN is configured. Does not grant Loop creation permission.
schema.title: X-Agentguard-Token

parameters.description: Conditional global API credential: required when AGENTGUARD_API_TOKEN is configured. Does not grant Loop creation permission.

503.description: The API audit event could not be persisted.

get.description:
Message-level interaction graph with explicit availability and provenance.

Real edges come only from message metadata that WARDEN's public run
response provided. Without it the response reports ``available=false``;
an explicit ``run_id`` renders the synthetic engine report through the
same contract, always labelled ``agentguard_synthetic_report``. With
``include_findings=true`` metadata-based risk findings are mounted as
ids on the recorded edges.
